contests.notes: Grouped printed slate totals. Roosevelt DEM electors: Henry M. Beard, Ed Cahill, Claire N. Webb, E. T. Williams, Jr. Dewey REP electors: Mary A. Feg tly [source reads Fegtly], E. V. O'Malley, Thomas H. O'Brien, C. B. Wilson. Watson P electors: F. H. Chadwick, Mrs. J. A. LeMay, Don M. Headley, Will S. James. Page6 repeats each elector with the same slate figure; no summation. Additional individual write-ins below are transcribed from p7, with raw party distinctions preserved; these are individual elector votes and must not be combined as presidential votes. Same-name entries appearing with different write-in/party labels are retained as distinct reported entries; no identity merge is inferred. County figures visually checked against the retained canvass; page 7 supplies county allocations for miscellaneous write-ins. Blank county cells in that complete write-in table are recorded as zero.

Pima printed cell appears 314 and is retained; do not repair from total.
